description: Load a page in the tenant's hosted browser and return the RENDERED html — the state after JavaScript has run, which a plain fetch cannot see. Required: url (http/https, public addresses only; internal and cloud-metadata addresses are refused). Optional: wait_ms (wait for the network to settle), max_chars (default 100000), stealth (ask Browserless to reduce automation signals; this does not solve or bypass CAPTCHA challenges).

stealth.description: Enable Browserless stealth launch mode. Does not solve CAPTCHA challenges.

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait for the network to settle

name: browser_fetch_page
